final: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '')) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '')) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items) SELECT o.order_id, o.average_quantity, o.average_quantity - b.average_quantity AS difference_from_baseline FROM order_averages AS o CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.average_quantity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_baseline IS NULL, difference_from_baseline DESC LIMIT 10
